column1: # The build applies these lines before synthesis. It never edits your script file.
# Spoken form: plain text is read as written; a part between slashes is a phoneme string
# (misaki / Kokoro alphabet: A = "ay", I = "eye", O = "oh", W = "ow", Y = "oy").
# Longer written forms win. Matching is case-sensitive, whole words only.
# The lines below are examples. Delete them or add your own.
